objectives.description: No re-implementation of audit-verdict check in hook
Register bare on Bash matcher in root-files/settings.json and merge-sources/settings-hooks.json
Test suite: 4 required cases + variants, register in provides.scripts

approaches_tried.approach: Scan COMMAND_SCAN (quote-stripped) for the literal 'active_projects' field name
approaches_tried.reason: the hazardous mention is almost always INSIDE the quoted jq filter argument (e.g. '.active_projects += [...]'), which COMMAND_SCAN's quote-strip erases by design (built for the git-family guards, where the hazard is argv STRUCTURE, not quoted text) -- this produced a false negative on the primary required case (a raw jq stage-then-mv write). Fixed by scanning the RAW $COMMAND for this one specific check, while keeping COMMAND_SCAN for the structural write-shape detection and the state-write.sh allow-check (where quote-stripping is still the correct, false-positive-avoiding choice).

deviations.description: Register the hook bare on the Bash PreToolUse matcher in root-files/settings.json
deviations.reason: root-files/settings.json's own header comment states it is install-once (never overwritten on an existing repo's resync) and that new hook registrations should go into merge-sources/settings-hooks.json instead, which propagates on every resync -- confirmed live precedent: guard-destructive-git.sh/guard-git-push.sh/validate-bounded-waiter.sh are present in merge-sources but validate-bounded-waiter.sh was MISSING from root-files/settings.json's Bash matcher (a real pre-existing divergence, not something this task introduced). Registered the new hook in BOTH files per the plan's explicit root-files/settings.json instruction (for a fresh install) AND merge-sources/settings-hooks.json (the file that actually reaches THIS already-deployed repo via Phase 9's resync). Widened file_scope to add the merge-source path.
